newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Telecom says demand for Telenotes strong.
newsitem.headline: Telecom says demand for Telenotes strong.

text.p: Telecom Corporation of New Zealand Ltd said on Tuesday its subsidiary TCNZ Finance expected a large number of applications for its recent Telenote issue would need to be declined due to strong demand.
TCNZ Finance has closed the first tranche of Telenotes offered, but will be launching a new tranche of Telenotes specifically for retail investors later in the week.
"Due to the strong demand, TCNZ Finance expects a large number of applications will need to be declined," the company said.
The new election date and coupon will be announced before May 9.

Government stock rates have dropped substantially since the 8.5 percent coupon was set and the $50 million allocation for retail investors is expected to be fully-subscribed, through applications already received and applications already posted to the registrar," it said.
